paragraph: Nick Broderick was hiking the Kettle Moraine State Forest in Wisconsin with his girlfriend Eva in August 2025. A bolt of lightning struck them both. Eva restarted his heart twice before help arrived. When Nick later described the moment he knew he would marry her, he said it felt electric. He proposed. She said yes.
